description.value: A Taco Bell fast-food location in Surrey serving Tex-Mex staples including tacos, burritos, and the Crunchwrap Supreme, with both dine-in seating and a drive-through lane. The restaurant also offers a Veggie Cravings Menu with vegetarian options such as the Cheesy Bean and Rice Burrito. Convenient for touring cyclists passing through the 56 Avenue corridor needing a quick, filling meal with online ordering and delivery available.
